description:
The Play: Five Guys isn't just selling burgers; they’re selling a "win." By dumping that extra scoop of fries in the bag, they trigger the Peak-End Rule. You walk out feeling like you got a massive deal, even though you paid a premium. It’s a masterclass in psychological over-delivery.

The Breakdown: Original curation and visual breakdown by Market Mojo. I flipped this clip with original commentary and data overlays to show the "why" behind the buy.

The Credit: Original insights from Rory Sutherland.

The Legal: This video is for educational and transformative purposes (Fair Use). It provides original commentary and a thoughtful revision, contributing added value beyond the original sources.
